query.text: Signals baud_div_q, tick_baud_q, bit_cnt_q, bit_cnt_d, sreg_q, sreg_d, and tx_d are declared but not read or driven in this region; they may be unused if not referenced elsewhere.

matches.text: When tx_enable is high, wr is low, tick_baud_q is high, and bit_cnt_q is non-zero, sreg_d is shifted right with a 1 inserted at the MSB ({1'b1, sreg_q[10:1]}), tx_d outputs the LSB sreg_q[0], and bit_cnt_d is decremented by 1.

When tx_enable is high but neither wr nor the shift condition (tick_baud_q && bit_cnt_q != 0) is true, all driven signals hold their previous flopped values (bit_cnt_d = bit_cnt_q, sreg_d = sreg_q, tx_d = tx_q).
When rx_enable is 1 and tick_baud_x16 is 1, baud_div_d increments by 1, and tick_baud_d is set to 1 on overflow (carry out of 4‑bit addition).
